subject: Web Development
title: V8: Chrome's Speed Machine
description: A 60-second lesson on V8: Chrome's Speed Machine.

hook.text: When Chrome launched in 2008, its secret weapon wasn't the UI. It was the V8 engine.

buildup.text: V8 compiles JavaScript directly to machine code instead of interpreting it line by line.

discovery.text: This 'just-in-time' compilation made JavaScript run ten times faster than before.

twist.text: V8 later escaped the browser. It became the engine behind Node.js and server-side JS.

climax.text: One engine transformed JavaScript from a toy scripting language into a full platform.

punchline.text: V8 made JavaScript fast enough to matter.
